# ProviderChoice

An explicit choice when a provider cannot serve: wait (free) or switch (paid, changes provenance).

`AIA.ProviderChoice` · Money

## Use

```jsx
<AIA.ProviderChoice provider="claude_code_subscription" reason="…" policy="CLAUDE_CODE_ONLY" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AIA.ProviderChoice" provider="claude_code_subscription" reason="…" policy="CLAUDE_CODE_ONLY"></x-import>
```
